title: Not bad, could be better
content: This game is honestly pretty fun, I’ve played loads of it. It gives you decent rewards, but my biggest issue with this game is how many ads there are. There is an option to buy skip ad tokens, but no option to pay to permanently remove them. This game is practically unplayable to me unless I can skip the ads, so I end up avoiding it to not spend money. Most of the items in the game to progress are pretty expensive in game currency as well and it can feel like a grind at times where you are stuck on a level playing the side challenges over and over or considering buying your way through. That being said I do think this game has some charm and can be rather addictive. It’s also pretty surface level, I give 0 craps and don’t really feel any interest in the small stories or interactions they add in between each scene or for any of the characters. Although I don’t think this game was really going for depth. It’s fun for what it is, but the micro transactions CONSTANTLY being shoved in your face and ads are insanely annoying. The skip ad tokens are also sometimes automatically used when claiming rewards to double them without asking. There’s promise to this game but also a lot of room for improvement.

After about a week of this, I have finally had enough. The developers could fix this by allowing gamers to choose how to dress the models themselves. The majority of the clothing is not cute anyway. The outfits are horrible once all required items are used. Of course, there is less money to be made if the developers allowed gamers to create their own outfits. All of these games have turned into money grabs. None of these developers actually care about gamer enjoyment. They would rather get as much money as possible from players who will eventually quit than create an experience that will keep loyal players and attract new ones.

author: Prediinikki
title: Dislike the portrayal of black characters
content: I really enjoy the concept of Glam and the styling aspect of the game, but there is one thing that has been bothering me enough that I feel it needs to be addressed. I’ve noticed a repeated pattern with the dark-skinned Black female character. Almost every time she appears, she is portrayed as sassy, demanding, having an attitude, or being unnecessarily difficult. She is often introduced as a high-profile client who needs to look polished, but the interactions themselves rarely feel warm or respectful, and even her compliments when leaving tend to come across as backhanded or condescending. What makes this especially noticeable is that the other female characters seem to have much more variety in their personalities, stories, relationships, and struggles. They aren’t repeatedly reduced to the same stereotype. I understand that characters can have different personalities and that a confident or demanding character isn’t automatically a problem, but when the same traits are repeatedly attached to the dark-skinned Black woman, it becomes difficult not to see the stereotype behind the writing. Representation matters, especially in a game where players are interacting with these characters repeatedly. I would really like to see this character given more depth, warmth, and personality beyond the “sassy Black girl” trope. I genuinely enjoy the game, which is why I hope the developers take this criticism seriously and consider giving her the same range and complexity they give the other characters.

title: Fairness issues/unaddressed support concerns
content:
I’ve been a long‑time Glow Fashion Idol player, and recent updates have created noticeable fairness issues in the game. Some long‑term players were unable to access the Cherry Blossom Collection due to how the Collection Quest was structured, while exceptions were made for others. The Club feature also rolled out unevenly, giving certain players advantages before others had access.
I reached out to support several times with detailed explanations. After days of automated replies, I finally received a human response — but it did not address any of the concerns I raised. It simply stated that my feedback was “shared with the team” and that there were no updates. None of the fairness issues were acknowledged or explained.
Major new features have also been released without tutorials or guidance, leaving players confused about how they work.
I enjoy the game, but fairness, consistency, and clear communication should matter. I hope future updates take these issues seriously and provide better support for long‑term players.

title: REALLY amazing game, just needs a few changes.

The three things I hate about this game is the use of ai in some pictures, the fact you have to pay in game money to pass certain clients, and the short events.

I like it when it’s just one a couple hours, but not when you get one after another. Like I wanna save up for a dress I really like, but I can’t because I have to buy stuff for clients all the time.

Then, the events. The events ONLY last like, 6 or 5 days tops, even when I need literally more than that to get the certain items the events give me. It’s impossible to finish the events or get more than 3 gifts just in that many days. 

But overall, this game is AMAZING. the graphics, the variety of clothes and models, it’s wonderful. I play this game frequently and I love the dynamics and gameplay. It’s fun and keeps you entertained. My favorite part is the contests and how you compete with people. 

This game is fun for all ages and I really recommend it if you’re a fashion person and a competitive player.

author: Lateacher65
title: Too Much $$ !!
content:
At first I was totally addicted to this game, and started buying small things here and there. But it adds up quick and it seems like the more you buy, the more pressure there is to buy.

For example, I loved doing the missions where I got to dress up my clients. Then it began with “you need to power up to get enough pts to complete this mission” & you don’t have enough coins. Next, it was “you have to buy this dress in a certain color etc” to complete this mission. Now, I’m completely stuck with some ridiculous requirement that I can’t fulfill and calculated I’d have to spend about $20-$30 to fulfill the requirements and finish the mission!! Forget it, that’s real $ and I’ve spent enough already!

So I thought if I just left the mission incomplete I could move on and get another mission, but instead I’ve been stuck on that same mission for several days now! NO NEW missions have been assigned to me!

Then they give you  fun games to play, but of course you have to buy pieces, or yarn, etc. to make a move and complete it! (More $$ !!)

Then there were other ways to earn rewards, like the chain rewards. Spend $2.99 and unlock this rewards + 2 free ones. Except the last TWO or THREE times I paid, the free rewards kept saying “video is unavailable right now, check back later” and I NEVER got my free stuff! Also, the daily rewards you’d get free stuff, until those began saying the same thing for the last 4 or more times “video unavailable” so no free rewards!

It’s funny how things don’t work when it’s free, but they’re working fine when it comes to taking my $$!!!

As much as I fell in love with this game, I’m quickly falling OUT of love and may soon have to delete the app if I can’t move on & videos continue to be unavailable for the free stuff!! I’m becoming more & more disappointed each day. 😒

author: Jana McC_94
title: Redoing my review
content:
So yeah I wrote my last review perhaps a little too hastily. Now that I’ve been at it for about a week- I’ve run into some more issues so I’m just gonna start over. 

First off this game still really is the best fashion game I’ve played out of all the top fashion games. There’s quite a few different contests and mini games that are in rotation. Easy way to earn currency. And then there’s also the graphics ✨The 3D models in this game are amazing and I love the movement physics given to the clothing. Sparkly shoes? Look closely and you’ll notice each individual rhinestone which is so pretty. And earrings so shiny they’re straight up trying to act like mini lighthouses lol 

The game is also extremely generous with ad rewards. A cute little cat comes by very often gifting coins, power ups and both forms of premium gem currency. Also the limited time mini game currency gets ads as well so free to play people are set.

I’ve seen people mention ai dialogue but the mission dialogue isn’t bad at all and you’re able to skip it if you’d like.

Now this is where I start getting to the cons I’ve noticed.

First the collab contests don’t work properly. I just recently unlocked them and tried it and got through choosing my outfit- but once it started nothing but an empty stage and the music played. This happened twice. Third time it happened but eventually started working correctly until the game errored out and forced me to quit halfway through. I don’t know if it was the game or my connection but it has stated that if I leave I’d lose a collab point. I still don’t have any so it’s not a major problem, but if I had I’d be losing them for stuff that’s still not my fault.

And secondly- I would definitely warn against playing on two different devices even if both are under the same account. The game does not currently possess a restore purchase function. I have the game first on my iPad and then I put it briefly on my iPhone under same Game Center account and purchased a small pack on my phone and it did not transfer back over to the other device. I even tried reinstalling the game on my iPad and it did nothing. So I had to purchase it a second time. Pick the main device you wish to play on and stick with that.

Lastly I have now hit a purchase block. I’m on a mission that requires a piece of grey clothing and the only grey clothing available to use is from a $12 dollar pack. I’m not against buying it but I have to wait until I can. But this would put a full stop on free to play people. You can do the other side contests but the main missions you level up from are fully blocked because of this which is unfortunate.

A restore purchase button and better account syncing would be fantastic. Also clearing up the main mission blocks.

Also I don’t know if I’ve just not gotten far enough in game but I hope hats are added. I think they’re needed sometimes as that finishing touch. And when entering contests I wish there was a way to go back and see our submitted looks. That would be great!😊 The game is still really fun and definitely worth a try!!

author: MelodySweetSpirit
title: Great, But Weird Theme Requirements and AI
content:
I really enjoy this game, it’s fun to style, and the collaboration Runways are a lot of fun— however, there are a lot of weird requirements that lead me to some legitimate recommendations I genuinely hope you consider:
1. Let us wear coats and bags on Style Roulette—it really doesn’t make sense to forbid those.
2. Change the requirements on a lot of those Themes—why would Business and Bling ever mean “Sportswear”? Why would “Tan Lines and Trends” ever mean “White, Romantic”? That SCREAMS “Wedding”, and that’s what everyone but me did (I won).
3. I think it would be fun to gain access (by having to save up) to much higher rarity clothing items—like stuff with wings or hair accessories, and I think it would be cool to get more clothing categories, like hosiery, gloves, etc. 
4. Stop using AI “Artwork”. There are a lot of people who would love to create poster art, and I know you make money with this game and would be 100% capable of paying them for it. The current Poster has candles phasing out of a mirror—it just doesn’t look good.
5. This one isn’t too big a concern, but I notice things clipping through other things—like clothes through limbs/hair (and vice versa).

author: SandraCouture
title: 💖 One of the Best Fashion Games I’ve Played
content:
I’ve really enjoyed playing Glow Fashion Idol. The game is fun, creative, and addictive, and it’s clear that a lot of work went into the designs, story, and gameplay. I’ve spent many hours playing and continue to enjoy progressing through the missions.

That said, I think there are a few areas that could be improved. One of the biggest frustrations is finding outfits and collections. If I click on a clothing item, it would be incredibly helpful if there were an easier way to view the entire collection that item belongs to. Right now it can be difficult and 
time-consuming to locate matching pieces.

I would also love to see more interactions with the clients and more story content. Side stories would make the game even more engaging, especially involving Ethan and the main character. It feels like their relationship and interactions reset frequently, and it would be nice to see more character development and continuity.

Overall, Glow Fashion Idol is a fantastic game and one of the most enjoyable fashion games I’ve played. The developers have done an amazing job, and with a few quality-of-life improvements and additional story content, it could be even better.

author: dabeesknees0801
title: You won’t find a better fashion game on the App Store
content:
I LOVE this game. I have spent an embarrassing amount of hours on it. I love that it’s “free player” friendly. It allows me to earn through ads, it has a dozen optional mini-games, and the daily challenges. 

You can purchase design packages, but it’s only required for a select few of the daily contests—overall completely optional to pay-to-play. Which is great, unless you have responsibilities throughout the day (I have lost many days in the two years I’ve played).

I’d like to also mention that the game has expanded a ton since I first signed up! The furniture mini-game upgrade was a literal game-changer, as if I didn’t obsess over glow enough. Now, you can also change the color of select clothing items by upgrading your outfits, and it’s a dream come true. 

The only things I would change: 
1. You can’t change your avatar after sign up, and there aren’t many model options to choose from to begin with. 

2. You can’t use a purse for daily contests, only client tasks. Big bummer. (PLEASE CHANGE THIS, I BEG)

3. You can’t wear a coat with a dress ever. I wish that at least certain coats were allowed to pair with dresses. 

4. I wish you could earn 100 diamonds instead of 50 with ads, but I’m just greedy. 

Otherwise, wouldn’t change a thing. 10/10 recommend this game.

author: EzraZT
title: Feedback for the Developers and Team
content:
This message is intended for the developers, creators, and anyone involved in improving the game’s features and overall player experience. As a dedicated player who genuinely enjoys and supports the game, I wanted to share some feedback and suggestions that I believe could make it even better.

I work in luxury retail and genuinely love this game. I play it with the same passion that I bring to my work, which is why I’m taking the time to share this feedback. My comments come from a place of appreciation because I truly enjoy the game and want to see it continue to grow.

First, I don’t mind spending money on the game, and I have spent quite a bit because I enjoy it. However, I feel that some features should be more accessible and give players greater creative freedom.

One of my biggest frustrations is the lack of freedom when it comes to styling. Fashion is all about creativity, layering, and self-expression, yet there are restrictions that make it difficult to create complete looks. For example, coats and jackets cannot be used in collaboration contests, even when they would be an important part of the outfit. Players also cannot wear coats or jackets with dresses. If a dress is selected, outerwear becomes unavailable, and vice versa. In fashion, outerwear is often a key part of a look and can completely transform an outfit. Allowing dresses and coats to be worn together would create more realistic, stylish, and versatile looks.

Another area that needs improvement is the closet organization system. During timed contests and battles, it can be difficult to quickly find specific pieces because everything feels scattered and disorganized. A lot of time is spent searching instead of styling. Organizing items by color, collection, style, or adding better filtering options would make the experience much smoother. Alternatively, extending the time limit for contests and battles would help players create more thoughtful looks without feeling rushed.

I also find the mission system frustrating at times. Too often, the focus shifts from creating beautiful, coordinated outfits to simply achieving the required score. This can result in looks that feel mismatched because players are forced to use whatever items will earn the most points. The heavy reliance on power-ups adds to this issue. Powering up items becomes increasingly expensive, requiring significantly more coins as levels increase. It would be nice to see a better balance where styling and creativity are rewarded more, rather than making progression feel dependent on constant upgrades.

I would also love to see more customization options. While there is a great variety of hairstyles, the makeup, nail polish, and hair color selections feel much more limited in comparison. Expanding these categories would give players more opportunities to create unique looks and express different styles.

Overall, I truly enjoy this game and appreciate the work that goes into it. These suggestions come from someone who spends a lot of time playing, supports the game financially, and wants to see it become even better. Fashion is about creativity and self expression, and giving players more freedom to style, layer pieces, and organize their wardrobes would make the experience even more enjoyable for everyone.

Thank you for taking the time to read my feedback, and I hope some of these suggestions can be considered in future updates.
